mechanism: Chlorpromazine may increase corticosteroid metabolism via CYP3A4 induction, while triamcinolone can potentiate chlorpromazine's anticholinergic and CNS depressant effects; both drugs increase infection risk through immunosuppression.
action: Monitor for reduced corticosteroid efficacy and increased infection risk; adjust triamcinolone dose if needed and counsel on infection prevention; observe for enhanced anticholinergic side effects.
